title: Navigable JSON as a Turing machine: orchestration patterns
summary: Navigable JSON lets an agent skip bodies it does not need. This case asks if the file can be a program — sequence, selection, iteration as primitives, context as RAM. Both ship as runnable code.

artifacts.note: the article: the Bohm-Jacopini mapping, both orchestration patterns as runnable JavaScript, a canonical linker and reader, a live-offset demo program, and a live model run
